title.narrative: Diversificazione produttiva e rafforzamento del sistema alimentare locale nel municipio di Guanabacoa
Productive diversification and local food system strengthening in the municipality of Guanabacoa

description.narrative: L’iniziativa mira a contribuire alla sostenibilità del sistema alimentare locale del municipio di Guanabacoa attraverso il miglioramento della gestione della filiera lattiero-caseario nel territorio, con un approccio basato sulla diffusione di pratiche agroecologiche, la gestione efficiente delle risorse naturali, la promozione di reti di imprese e dell’economia locale. L’intervento contribuisce a rafforzare la capacità di governance del settore agroalimentare supportando le autorità locali nella definizione di strategie e politiche di sviluppo locale che favoriscano la partecipazione degli attori della filiera ed alleanze pubblico-private. Il fine è quello di contribuire allo sviluppo socioeconomico e all’approvvigionamento alimentare sostenibile a livello locale in risposta alla precarietà alimentare e alla crisi economica che caratterizzano le aree interessate dall’intervento. Il principale cambiamento di breve-medio periodo che l’iniziativa intende produrre è quello di Rafforzare lo sviluppo della catena del valore lattiero-casearia quale contributo alla gestione diversificata del Sistema Alimentare Locale. Attraverso l’adozione di un approccio di filiera si intende aumentare l’offerta, diversificandola, di prodotti derivati principalmente dal latte delle bufale.

The initiative aims to contribute to the local food system sustainability in Guanabacoa municipality by the improvement of the dairy value chain management. This is based on the dissemination of agroecological practices, efficient natural resource management, and promotion of local business networks. The intervention helps to strengthen the governance of the agri-food sector supporting local authorities to defining strategies and policies for local development that encourage the participation of supply chain actors by public private partnerships. The goal is to contribute to socio-economic development and sustainable food supply at the local level in response to food insecurity and the economic crisis of the country. The main short to medium-term change the initiative aims to achieve is to strengthen the development of the dairy value chain as a contribution to the diversified management of the Local Food System. Through the adoption of a supply chain approach, the intention is to increase the supply and diversify dairy products from buffalo milk.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life
